verdict.rationale: PostHog claims a built-in AI assistant ('PostHog AI') that can write Hog functions for you and an agentic feature that turns product signals into researched reports and PRs you review and merge, suggesting task delegation to an in-app AI (docs-28, gh-1). However, a hands-on community report describes the LLM assistant failing a basic delegated task (creating a SQL-based cohort, incorrectly claiming it was impossible) and causing severe client-side performance degradation (comm-8), directly contradicting the smooth delegation experience implied by the docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation clearly naming/describing the assistant's capabilities and scope, and independent corroboration that it reliably completes delegated tasks.
